outcome: After a successful paper-book check, download the complete existing reconciliation-result JSON for local record keeping. The original report cutoff, decimal text, differences, account binding and book digests are preserved.

scope.quantEngine: Unchanged, reused without rebuilding or restarting
scope.writeSemantics: No new API request or server/account/journal/report-history write on download
scope.format: UTF-8 JSON, LF; existing paper-reconciliation-result-v1, not a ledger backup/import format
scope.filename: ASCII UTC original-report time plus reconciliationId prefix; no account ID or personal path
scope.gating: No valid report, wrong account/basis, check pending/failed, or ledger action pending: download disabled. Failure retains the report and permits retry; refresh/new report clears old download notices.

web.reuse: After the URL-release timing fix, its 11 export cases were rerun and passed; unchanged report/page cases reuse the successful targeted run.

verification.tdd: New export test first failed because the implementation module was absent; health-version test first failed against 1.0.16, then passed against 1.0.17.
verification.behavior: Complete MATCHED and DRIFTED payloads, all three difference kinds, long/signed/trailing-zero decimal strings, nanosecond cutoff, UTC filename, account/time/status/shape validation, disabled states, download exception and resource cleanup.
verification.static: Web tsc, scoped ESLint/Prettier and diff checks passed. Server compiled in the affected Docker build. No redundant local Python/full-repository suite.
verification.build: Initial Server/Web images built successfully. One independent URL-release finding triggered a Web-only rebuild; Server reused. Quant, database and worker inputs/state unchanged.

independentReview.finding: Successful download now keeps the Blob URL alive for 1 second; exceptions release immediately. Hidden anchor removed in both paths. Fake-timer tests verify exact cleanup timing.
independentReview.closure: Final source, 11 export cases, actual downloaded payloads and unchanged ledger/journal evidence reviewed; no remaining blocking findings.

actualBrowser.environment: Actual local built Server/Web with unchanged quant-engine
actualBrowser.initialState: Download natively disabled until a successful check
actualBrowser.keyboard: Return check then Return download succeeded; final focus BUTTON / 下载核对报告

isolatedUiFixture.driftDownload: Downloaded JSON equals the complete producer response at verification time, including all 3 differences and -0.00000001.
isolatedUiFixture.unavailableStates: Actual no-report/check-failure/check-pending states disable download; failure preserves prior report and clears stale success notice; successful retry enables download again.
isolatedUiFixture.viewport: 390x844; document clientWidth/scrollWidth both 375; dark mode; pointer when enabled, not-allowed when disabled.
isolatedUiFixture.scope: Presentation and client-state verification only; not engine or accounting proof.
isolatedUiFixture.cleanup: Owned fixture process/tab and generated acceptance downloads removed; exact copies retained under ignored work; viewport reset.

verification.reusedEvidence: Unchanged 1.0.16 reconciliation API, Decimal accounting, authentication, persistence/restart and recovery evidence. Current source CI separately runs configured repository gates and zero-write backtest regression.

ci.scope: Configured repository quality gates and zero-write backtest regression passed on all three platforms; build on the configured Linux job.

limits: The file contains the selected reconciliation snapshot, not full cash/position details, account history or recovery commands.
No server report history, import/repair, automatic day-end task, sell, market matching or real-broker capability.
No full P6-N11, P6-N12 or Phase 6 exit acceptance.
Actual browser download verified in local Chrome; three-platform CI is source/tooling evidence, not native browser acceptance on every platform.
